name: urdu-text-utils/urdu-text-utils
description: Zero-dependency Urdu text processing: normalization, collation, transliteration, search, numbers, detection, tokenization, statistics, stop words, stemming, dates, and name transliteration. PHP port of the TypeScript urdu-text-utils, consuming the same generated tables.

suggest.ext-intl: Provides true Unicode NFKC/NFC normalization; without it a generated presentation-form fallback is used.
suggest.ext-mbstring: Handy for multibyte string work around the library; not required by it.
